requirements.text: When the retro-reflector is illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° (or β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° if 0° produces a colourless surface reflection), the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red of retro-reflected light defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the retro-reflected light with a colorimeter under Illuminant A at the specified geometry and compare them with the R48 red boundaries.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7, shall meet the shape and dimension requirements of Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5, paragraph 1.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7, shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements of paragraphs 5.1.4 to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform the RI photometry and night-time colorimetry on the test samples.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements of paragraph 5.1.7 that apply to the nature of its materials and construction.
requirements.test_case: Run the heat, water, fuel/oil, corrosion, rear-face, stability and weathering tests that apply, in the prescribed order.

requirements.text: The moulded plastics Class IA/IB retro-reflector shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by cooling for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples in a dry oven at 65 °C for 48 h, then condition them at 23 °C for 1 h.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, the retro-reflector, and in particular its optical component, shall show no visible cracking or appreciable distortion.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the samples for cracks and distortion after the heat test.

requirements.text: At least one hour after the heat resistance test, the retro-reflector shall meet the colorimetric requirements of 5.1.5 and the RI of 5.1.4 at a divergence angle of 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° (or the position defined in Annex 4 Part 1, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2). The samples with the minimum and maximum RI shall meet the complete photometry of 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour and RI at 20'/0° on all samples, then run complete photometry on the min and max samples.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, it shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 and shall afterwards meet the colour and RI requirements of 5.1.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Run the salt-spray corrosion test, then check colour and RI at 20'/0°.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, it shall be subjected to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face in Part 5 of Annex 6 and shall afterwards meet the colour and RI requirements of 5.1.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear face with the fuel/oil mixture per Annex 6 Part 5, then measure RI and colour.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be subjected to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7) after a satisfactory water penetration test, and shall afterwards meet the colour and RI requirements of 5.1.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to the n-heptane/toluol mixture and to lubricating oil per Annex 7, then check colour and RI.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties (Part 3 of Annex 4) and shall meet the colour and RI requirements of 5.1.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Assess the stability-in-time samples, then measure colour and RI at 20'/0°.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6) and shall afterwards meet the colour and RI requirements of 5.1.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to accelerated weathering per EN ISO 4892-2, then check colour and RI.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests of paragraph 5.1.3.1, the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions of paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the night-time trichromatic coordinates after each test group (visual check; coordinates in case of doubt).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests of paragraph 5.1.3.1, the retro-reflectors in each group shall have an RI satisfying paragraph 5.1.4, verified at a divergence angle of 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° after each test group and compare with Table 3 (red: 300 mcd/lx).

requirements.text: Where more than one axis of reference, or a range of axes, is specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the RI requirements with respect to each specified axis of reference or to the extreme axes of the range.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the photometric measurements for each declared reference axis or extreme of the range.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements of the Class IA/IB retro-reflector, only the illuminating surface contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter shall be considered. This surface is defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system as indicated by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check on the drawing and sample that the declared illuminating surface lies within a 200 mm diameter circle.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface considered for photometry shall be limited to 100 cm², though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure the declared illuminating surface area and confirm it is not more than 100 cm².

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector shall be equal to or greater than the following values (mcd/lx). At divergence 20': 300 at β1=0°/β2=0°, 200 at β1=±10°/β2=0°, 100 at β1=±5°/β2=±20°. At divergence 1°30': 5 at 0°/0°, 2.8 at ±10°/0°, 2.5 at ±5°/±20°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI at each listed divergence/illumination angle combination and compare with the minima.

requirements.text: Within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°), the RI values of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector shall not be lower than the Table 3 values at the boundary of that solid angle (100 mcd/lx at 20' and 2.5 mcd/lx at 1°30').
requirements.test_case: Scan the RI within the bounded solid angle at both divergence angles and confirm no value falls below the limit.

requirements.text: In case the Class IA/IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values may be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the declared mounting height; if it is below 750 mm, verify the downward RI only to 5°.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", its RI at β1 = β2 = 0° (or the angle specified in paragraph 5) and a divergence of 20', measured in the rotational position about the axis of reference giving minimum RI, shall conform to paragraph 5. The device may be rotated ±5° from that position if the specified values for the other angles are not attained.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the sample about its reference axis to the minimum-RI position and measure the RI at all required angles.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 4.2.1 (CIE Standard Illuminant A, divergence 1/3°, β1 = β2 = 0°), the trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red specified in UN Regulation No. 48. This applies whether the colour comes from a red optical unit or from a colourless unit behind the red outer lens acting as filter.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the retro-reflected light with a spectroradiometer under Illuminant A and check it against the R48 red night-time boundaries.

requirements.text: Mass-produced retro-reflectors (Class IA/IB, red) shall conform to the approved type from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Dimensionally inspect production retro-reflectors against the approved type drawings and the Annex 5 Class IA/IB shape and dimension requirements.

requirements.text: When the photometric performance of any production retro-reflector chosen at random is tested, no measured value of the coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL) shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL of randomly selected production retro-reflectors at the prescribed angles and check that every value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: Production retro-reflectors shall comply with the prescribed chromaticity coordinates for red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of randomly selected production retro-reflectors and verify they lie within the red boundaries of the Regulation.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", its RI shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position reached while it is rotated about its axis by ±5° at β1 = β2 = 0° (or the specified angle) and a divergence angle of 20'.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its reference axis at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, record RI continuously and check it never falls below 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: If the RI of the retro-reflector at β1 = β2 = 0° and ε = 0° exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, compliance at all angles of illumination and divergence shall be assessed at ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at ε = 0°, β1 = β2 = 0° and 20'; if ≥ 150 % of the requirement, perform all Table 3 measurements at ε = 0°.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA/IIIB (trailers) when viewed from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm its shape cannot be easily confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not and stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand immersion for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface. The immersion is repeated after turning the device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water. The device is then immediately immersed under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C. This applies to Class IA, and to Class IB unless the alternative moisture and dust test is applied.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector (or lamp assembly) at 50 °C for 10 min in each orientation, then at 25 °C, as prescribed.

requirements.text: After the water immersion test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit. If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: After immersion, visually inspect the prism reflecting surface for any water ingress.

requirements.text: If visual inspection after the water immersion test does not reveal water, or in case of doubt, the retro-reflector's coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) shall still satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4. The device is first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside. RI is measured per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or if necessary in all positions of Annex 4 Part 1, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Shake off excess water and measure RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° on the goniometer; compare with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test applied, the device shall be exposed to a solid cone water spray at a precipitation rate of 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, directed downward at 45° ± 5°, while rotating about its vertical axis at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Run the water spray cabinet test with the calibrated precipitation rate and rotation speed and record the parameters.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test applied, because the retro-reflector is grouped or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position, stop and reversing lamps, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray in a cycle of 5 min ON and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Energise the lamp functions at design voltage with a 5/55 min timer during the spray test and log the cycles.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test applied, the water spray exposure shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min), followed by a 1 hour drain period with rotation and spray turned off and the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test log shows 12 h of spray exposure followed by 1 h of draining.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test applied, after the drain period no standing pool of water shall have formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be formable by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After draining, inspect the interior visually, tap and tilt the lamp, and check for pooled water.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture test applied, after the water spray test and with the exterior dried, the RI of the retro-reflector measured according to Part 1 of Annex 4 shall satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 (divergence 20', illumination β1 = β2 = 0°).
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI on a goniophotometer at 20' divergence and 0° illumination after the test and compare it with the required value.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the dust test applied, the device shall be exposed for 5 hours in a dust chamber charged with 3 to 5 kg of fine powdered cement to ASTM C 150-84, with the dust agitated every 15 min for 2 to 15 s and allowed to settle between agitations.
requirements.test_case: Perform the dust chamber exposure with the specified dust, charge and agitation cycle, and record the parameters.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the dust test applied, after the dust exposure and with the exterior cleaned and dried, the RI of the retro-reflector measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 shall satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI at 20' divergence and 0° illumination after the dust test and compare it with the required value.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector (Class IA/IB) shall be designed so that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the ISO 9227:2017 salt-mist corrosion test, then re-measure photometric and colorimetric values against the R150 limits.

requirements.text: The front surface of the retro-reflector shall resist tarnishing, and the protection of its rear face shall resist deterioration, when tested for corrosion according to ISO 9227:2017, particularly where an essential metal component is liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: After the ISO 9227:2017 salt-mist exposure, visually inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear-face protection for deterioration.

requirements.text: Because the retro-reflector is combined with a light, the complete lamp, stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand a saline mist for 50 hours, comprising two 24-hour exposure periods separated by a 2-hour interval in which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the stripped rear lamp in a salt-spray chamber for 2 × 24 h with a 2 h drying interval between them, then evaluate it.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion (e.g. a metallised mirror-backed rear face), the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at 35 °C ± 2 °C, a solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify the salt-spray chamber settings (35 ± 2 °C, 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water) in the test report for a retro-reflector with metal components.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt-mist exposure for corrosion that could impair retro-reflective efficiency.

requirements.text: After a recovery period of 48 hours following the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, measured as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6 at an entrance angle β2 = 5° and an observation angle α = 20', shall be not less than the minimum value of the referenced Table 9 and not more than the maximum value of the referenced Table 10.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and removal of salt deposits, measure RA at β2 = 5° and α = 20' and compare the result with the referenced limits.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed retro-reflector (Class IA or IB moulded plastics) with an accessible rear face, the rear face shall withstand, after being brushed with a hard nylon brush, the application for one minute of a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol (Annex 7 Part 1), followed by drying and brushing again with the same brush.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear face, apply a cotton cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol for 1 min, let dry, brush again, then inspect and proceed to the RI measurement.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) with an accessible rear face, after the rear-face solvent and brushing test and with the whole mirror-backed rear face covered with Indian ink, the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI) shall still satisfy the conditions of paragraph 5.1.4, verified at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° (or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2).
requirements.test_case: Cover the whole tested rear face with Indian ink and measure RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°, then compare the result with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits for red Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector, in particular its illuminating surface, shall withstand exposure to a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol, applied by lightly wiping with a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector with a cotton cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol.

requirements.text: About five minutes after wiping with the n-heptane/toluol test mixture, the outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks are not objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface about 5 minutes after application for surface changes other than slight cracks.

requirements.text: After its outer surface, in particular the illuminating surface, has been exposed for about 5 minutes to a detergent lubricating oil (lightly applied with a soaked cotton cloth) and then cleaned, the Class IA/IB moulded plastics retro-reflector shall have a coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL) that still meets paragraph 5.1.4. This is checked at an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, or if necessary in all positions specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraphs 1.1 and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface with detergent lubricating oil, wait 5 min and clean it, then measure the CIL at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° and compare with the paragraph 5.1.4 limits.

requirements.text: The external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface (outer lens, exposed housing/bezel, exposed seal) which, with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and access lids closed, are at a height of more than 2 metres.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the installed lamp's exposed surfaces above ground with the vehicle in laden condition.

requirements.text: The external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface which, with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and access lids closed, are below the floor line.
requirements.test_case: Determine the floor line on the laden vehicle and check the position of the lamp surfaces relative to it.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is recessed or overhung by the body, the external projection provisions do not apply to those parts of the rear lamp's external surface which, in their static condition and in operation, cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter (vehicle laden, all doors, windows and access lids closed).
requirements.test_case: Pass a 100 mm diameter sphere over the installed lamp area and identify the surfaces it cannot contact.

requirements.text: The external surface of the installed rear lamp (outer lens, exposed housing/bezel and any exposed seal) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by or brushing against it in a collision.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the installed lamp for outward-directed pointed, sharp or injurious projections.

requirements.text: The external surface of the installed rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp contour for hooks, open edges or gaps that could catch clothing or limbs.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the rear lamp's external surface (lens edges, housing/bezel rim) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this does not apply to parts protruding less than 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection per Annex 3 para 2 and gauge the radii of the exposed edges with radius gauges.

requirements.text: Where parts of the rear lamp's external surface protrude less than 5 mm (but 1.5 mm or more), their outward facing angles shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection height of the edge relative to the panel and inspect the outward facing angles for blunting.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the rear lamp's external surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A (e.g. an exposed TPE/silicone seal) may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the Shore A hardness of the exposed seal with it installed on the vehicle and confirm it is 60 Shore A or less.

requirements.text: For the Shore A hardness relaxation, the hardness of the rear lamp part shall be determined with the component as installed on the vehicle, using comparable measurements where a Shore A measurement is impossible.
requirements.test_case: Perform a Shore A durometer measurement on the seal in its installed position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Series-production rear lamps fitted to the approved M1 vehicle type shall conform to the approved type by meeting the external-projection requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6. This covers the exposed outer lens, any visible housing rim or bezel and any exposed seal, which must have no pointed or sharp outward parts, no catching parts, a radius of curvature of at least 2.5 mm, or the permitted protrusion- or hardness-based exemptions.
requirements.test_case: On production samples taken at random, measure edge radii and projection heights of the installed lamp per Annex 3 and Shore A hardness of any exposed soft parts, and compare with the approved type.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp protrudes beyond the panel nominal line and is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of the projection of the lamp may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of the lamp in its installed condition.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp's projection directly on the vehicle, or check it on the manufacturer's section drawing of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp protrudes beyond the panel nominal line and is mounted on a surface other than convex, and its projection cannot be determined by simple measurement, the dimension of the projection of the lamp shall be determined as the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over the lamp in constant contact with it.
requirements.test_case: Move a 100 mm diameter sphere over the installed lamp in constant contact and record the maximum variation of its centre from the panel nominal line.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that, under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test of the lamp on its vehicle mounting, then re-check position, orientation and photometry.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting design and check orientation after handling and vibration loading.

requirements.text: When fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling function of the rear lamp (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical angle of the lamp reference axis relative to the ground plane on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: When fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling function of the rear lamp shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal angle of the lamp reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: Any specific fitting instructions laid down by the lamp manufacturer shall be complied with when the rear lamp is installed.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the rear lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and on a flat, horizontal surface, in normal condition of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure height and orientation with the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right rear lamps forming a pair shall be fitted symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral positions of the left and right lamp outer geometry relative to the vehicle centreline.

requirements.text: The left and right rear lamps of a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this does not apply to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps for mirror symmetry.

requirements.text: The left and right rear lamps of a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on both left and right lamps.

requirements.text: The left and right rear lamps of a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of each function on the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo may be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear for the number and arrangement of logos in lamps.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a logo, the logo shall be a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo; all other logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo content of the lamp.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the pair requirements for the rear lamps shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Assess the pair symmetry of the lamps against the vehicle shape.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function's colour, position, orientation, visibility and wiring on the installed combination lamp.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each function of the rear lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions switched OFF.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the colour requirements of the stop lamp shall be fulfilled when the stop lamp and the rear position lamp are switched ON together.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity with the rear position lamp also ON.

requirements.text: In case a rear lamp function is a single lamp whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total projected area of the distinct parts in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts shall not exceed 75 mm, measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; this does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surface areas, or the gaps between segments, in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: In case a function is provided by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", either the projected apparent surfaces of the two lamps shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the distance between their facing edges shall not exceed 75 mm, measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surfaces of the two 'D' lamps as installed.

requirements.text: In case a function is provided by an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", the system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1 (60 per cent of the circumscribing quadrilateral or a gap of at most 75 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of the interdependent lamps.

requirements.text: Two or more lamps or separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body or behind a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, unless the lamp is in the shape of a band or strip.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp classification against the lamp body and lens construction.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of each rear lamp function shall be measured from the highest point, and the minimum height from the lowest point, of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above the ground.

requirements.text: For the purpose of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the height of the rear lamp above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the H-plane height of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The width position of each rear lamp function shall be determined from the edge of the apparent surface furthest from the median longitudinal plane for the overall-width distance, and from the inner edges of the apparent surfaces for the distance between lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the outer and inner edges of the apparent surfaces relative to the vehicle centreline and outer edge.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of each rear lamp function shall not be intentionally varied while the function is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Monitor the intensity, colour and apparent surface of each function over time while it is ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of a rear lamp function may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp provides another function, provided that any variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure the varied intensities and check them against the device regulation limits.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the visibility of the red apparent surfaces from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of any red function of the rear lamp for an observer moving within Zone 1 (between 1 m and 2.2 m height, bounded by planes at 15° outwards) in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform an observation or CAD sight-line check from Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the prohibition of red light to the front is deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of red light emitted by the rear lamp towards the front, as verified at lamp type approval, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking the vehicle body into account where applicable.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of red light emitted forward by the lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be such that they can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.test_case: Functional check of the lighting switch states and lamp activation.

requirements.text: The simultaneous switching requirement does not apply while the rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, while daytime running lamps are ON, or while the front position lamp function is substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Functional check of the parking-lamp and DRL modes.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all its light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Functional check of simultaneous activation of all interdependent lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be concealed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the lamp is permanently exposed.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the rear position lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the retro-reflected light.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall equal the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed functions on the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate), the lamp shall meet all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility and photometry at each fixed tailgate position.

requirements.text: In case the rear position or retro-reflector function on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check the 'D' lamp on the fixed part at all tailgate positions.

requirements.text: Additional rear position lamps or retro-reflectors may be switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that they satisfy all position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Measure the additional lamps with the tailgate open.

requirements.text: In case the rear position function on a movable component is provided by an interdependent lamp system, either the complete system on the movable component shall meet paragraph 5.18.1, or, if partly on the fixed component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified at device approval shall meet all position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check the specified interdependent lamps at all tailgate positions.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users when the movable component is in a position other than the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Assess glare and discomfort with the tailgate open.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer when the movable component is in the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the tailgate and re-measure lamp position and orientation.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden by more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure the obscured share of the apparent surface at each fixed position of the movable components.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent limit is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamp or retro-reflector shall be switched ON when the apparent surface is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify activation and photometry of the additional lamps in the obscuring positions.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; otherwise they are deemed not to be present.
requirements.test_case: Functional check that each function operates when installed with standard wiring and fuse.

requirements.text: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is allowed, provided that the replacement function is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the failed function and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and measure the colour, intensity and position of the replacement.

requirements.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the occurrence of the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check the tell-tale activation.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 that are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated shall vary in intensity all together, in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of both functions across the variable intensity range.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and the rear position lamp shall be maintained over the entire intensity range, including during variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop-to-position intensity ratio during transitions.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, the luminous intensity of the R2/S2 functions may increase or decrease within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light-emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Check the intensity range against the R148 limits under the simulated conditions.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, a decrease of the R2/S2 luminous intensity within the regulation limits is allowed while the vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m; an already activated decrease may remain active up to a vehicle speed of 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test of the intensity reduction at the speed and distance thresholds.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record the intensity over time during transitions.

requirements.text: For the stop lamp and rear position lamp tested at type approval with a special power supply, electronic light source control gear, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage, the voltage supplied at their terminals shall not exceed the voltage at which they were approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in the vehicle's constant voltage operating condition.

requirements.text: In other cases, for 12 V systems, the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle electrical system at constant voltage operation.

requirements.text: In other cases, for 24 V systems, the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage under constant voltage operation.

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the lamp terminals may be located within the body of the rear lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp circuit design for a voltage regulation means.

requirements.text: The terminal voltage limits of paragraphs 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 do not apply if the rear lamp includes an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control as part of the device.
requirements.test_case: Check the device documentation for integrated control gear or variable intensity control.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle within the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each rear lamp function observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: CAD or physical sight-line check of the visibility angles on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: If any part of the apparent surface of a rear lamp function is hidden by other vehicle parts when installed, the unhidden part of the lamp shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the lamp with the vehicle obscuration simulated.

requirements.text: When the vertical geometric visibility angle below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp less than 750 mm above the ground, measured from the H plane), the photometric field of measurement of the installed lamp may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the H-plane height and photometry down to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility with all interdependent lamps ON.

requirements.text: The LED modules of the rear lamp need not be replaceable, provided that this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet for the non-replaceable statement.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall be type approved according to UN R148, and the rear retro-reflector according to UN R150, when installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the approval markings and certificates for R148 and R150.

requirements.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to UN R148.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the R148 approval covers the lamp with its logo.

requirements.text: On M1 vehicles one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second reversing lamp device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and count the reversing lamps fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the R148 (or R23) approval mark and certificate of the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp apparent surface height above ground on the vehicle in the prescribed load condition.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle α of 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or by CAD that the reversing lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° up and 5° down.

requirements.text: If only one reversing lamp is fitted, the reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° to the right and to the left.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° left and right by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: If two reversing lamps are fitted, each reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of each apparent surface over 45° outwards and 30° inwards by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system start/stop device is in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: engage reverse with propulsion possible and confirm the lamp lights only under these conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system cannot operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse or switch off propulsion and confirm the lamp is off.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R148 requirements and verify the failure tell-tale operates by simulating LED failure.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 are mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of S1/S2 stop lamps.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the number of stop lamps and their R148/R7 approval marks.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, the point of the apparent surface of an S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake and confirm all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional check of stop lamp with propulsion system off (optional behaviour).

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear position lamps.

requirements.text: Two rear position lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the number of rear position lamps and their approval marks.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height above ground.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative at the manufacturer's discretion and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed, the rear position lamp horizontal geometric visibility may be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, with the inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify 45°/45° horizontal visibility.

requirements.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, with the downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm², excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles, excluding the retro-reflector area, and confirm ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, so that the front and rear position lamps (and end-outline, side-marker and rear registration plate lamps if fitted) can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and confirm simultaneous switching of all related lamps.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify the combined tell-tale lights.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.

requirements.text: Non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: Two rear retro-reflectors shall be fitted, type-approved according to the requirements for Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3 or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector R150 (or R3) Class IA/IB approval mark.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle outer edge.

requirements.text: As the rear retro-reflector is grouped with rear lamps, it shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,200 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector illuminating surface height above ground.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and below the horizontal; where it is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp layout for overlapping retro-reflector and lamp surfaces (permitted).

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, it shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all stop lamps fitted.
requirements.test_case: Trigger emergency braking above 50 km/h and confirm all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, all lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Measure the flash frequency and phase of the stop lamps during emergency stop signal operation.

requirements.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Operate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on/off and confirm independent operation.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: verify activation only above 50 km/h with emergency braking logic signal present.

requirements.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved; the rear combination lamp as installed in series production (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and the rear retro-reflector) shall therefore continue to meet the requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6.
requirements.test_case: On randomly selected production vehicles, carry out the Annex 9 checks of lamp visibility, position, orientation and luminous intensity of each function and compare them with the approved type and paragraphs 5 and 6.

requirements.text: In case the rear combination lamp is a grouped or reciprocally incorporated arrangement in which the non-textured outer lens is excluded and the apparent surface of one function (F1) is determined as '7b' according to paragraph 2.10.2, function F1 shall not be transparent to the light of function F2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing and sample with F2 lit and verify that no F2 light is transmitted through the F1 optical area when determining the apparent surface.
